features: 13.5" DIAMETER TRAYS: This Add-A-Tray 2-pack provides an additional 1.6 sq ft. of drying area
BPA FREE: Made of durable, high-quality food grade plastic – reusable & easy to clean (hand wash only)
EXPAND YOUR DEHYDRATOR: The Add-A-Tray enable you to maximize your favorite NESCO Dehydrator's capacity, allowing more space for your next harvest, snacks or jerky
MADE IN THE USA: Proudly made in the USA of global and domestic components

description: The NESCO LT-2SG Snackmaster Add-A-Trays expand your dehydrator as your needs grow. Our patented Converga-Flow drying system provides proper heat distribution that dehydrates foods faster and more evenly from top to bottom, with no tray rotation necessary. NESCO Snackmaster Add-A-Trays enable you to take advantage of your dehydrator by increasing the overall drying area. With additional trays, you can save time by drying larger batches. Drying efficiency is not altered by the addition of extra trays. HAND WASH ONLY. Made in the USA.
